items.title: Film promotion cancelled at Chennai’s Phoenix mall after chaos erupts from overcrowding
items.summary: Follow TNM’s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. Mishaps arising from overcrowding were averted at the Phoenix Marketcity mall in Chennai's Velachery on Saturday, August 8, after thousands of people gathered for a promotional event of the movie Meesaya Murukku 2 . The police cancelled the programme amid concerns of public safety and potential chaos. The non-ticketed event, organised at the mall for actor and musician Hiphop Tamizha Aadhi’s upcoming film, was expected to draw around 1,000 people, according to the police. However, a much larger crowd turned up after social media posts reportedly described the programme as a free musical event featuring Aadhi's performance. By Saturday evening, more than 2,000 people were reportedly gathered, with a large number of them thronging around the stage area. Police warned that the situation could lead to untoward incidents and advised Aadhi not to proceed with the event. The situation also triggered severe traffic congestion across Velachery and surrounding areas, with motorists stuck for several hours. items.title: Immediate FIR mandatory for missing adults too: Supreme Court clarifies order, warns States of contempt
items.summary: The Supreme Court has clarified that its direction requiring immediate registration of first information reports (FIRs) on receiving information about a missing person applies to adults as well as children, irrespective of age or gender. [G Ganesh v. State of Tamil Nadu & Ors] In an order passed on August 5, a Bench of Justices Ahsanuddin Amanullah and R Mahadevan expressed shock that some States had understood the expression "person" in its earlier order to refer only to children. " We find this to be a deliberate and mala fide bogey raised by such States. The language of our earlier order is clear and unambiguous. The expression 'person' means every person, irrespective of age or gender, " the Court said. Justices Ahsanuddin Amanullah and R Mahadevan The Bench was referring to its May 22 order directing States to register an FIR upon receiving information regarding any missing person.
